description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development - Declare the area of land called 'Rangiri Raja Maha Vihara Area'  as an Urban Development Area under the Town & Country Planning Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land and property-related matters. It declares a specific area of land ("Rangiri Raja Maha Vihara Area") as an urban development area under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance. The content includes detailed land descriptions, boundaries, and extent measurements (5.6641 Hectares), which are characteristic of land gazettes. While a minister is named, this is not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, but rather about the minister exercising statutory powers related to land development planning.
